We have test set evaluation result from evaluate_xgboost_model, which includes mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance (top 10). Need also cross-validation results: r2_mean and r2_std. Use perform_cross_validation on training data path from metadata. Let's get train_path. Already in metadata: "train_path": "/Users/.../oxide_ml_dataset/train.csv". Use that.

Call perform_cross_validation with target column formation_energy_per_atom, cv_folds 5, default hyperparameters (None).
